notes: bytearray holds one byte per flag; slice assignment (is_prime[p*p::p] = bytes(k)) crosses off multiples in C.
itertools.compress(range(n + 1), is_prime) yields only the primes, so the Python-level loop runs once per prime.
Python integers are unbounded, so the sum needs no 64-bit handling.
isascii() + isdigit() rejects signs, spaces and non-ASCII digits such as '²'.
